verdict.tagline: Deceptively deep management meets tense, unpredictable horror shifts.
for_you_if: you enjoy balancing business management with survival horror
you like uncovering hidden secrets and deep lore
you want a free game with surprising depth
not_for_you_if: you dislike unpredictable random difficulty spikes
you struggle with steep learning curves early on
you depend heavily on visual cues rather than audio

citations.review_text: This and Ultimate are free and I love it
This was one of my favorite FNAF games, The fact that it is a free game is insane, worth every cent you didn't use to buy it.

Its free so its good
love it. and its free!!

Hermosura, aún siendo el sexto juego, logra ser muy creativo, con personajes muy amados, una hsitoria buenísima y gameplay decente. Si bien es original en su gameplay, no es muy divertido ni innovador, pero difiere del resto, lo que lo ayuda a brillar. La historia es de las mejores si no es que la mejor de toda la saga, y es contada de todas las maneras que la marcaron en toda la saga. Vino en un momento pobre de la saga para ayudar a revivirla y encima completamente de regalo y gratis. 9.3/10

claims.claim: Reviewers report that the office segments rely heavily on random number generation and can feel unfair.

citations.review_text: To me, possibly the worst FNAF game out there. The tycoon and salvage part is really fun. However the office part of the game is so ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ awful, and not worth finishing for me. You just press two buttons on monitor, then stare five minutes into the vents, and repeat for around thirty minutes. If you get unlucky, you will die like 25 minutes into the night. The office part also heavily relies on RNG, which makes everything even more frustrating.

The Actual Nights: The weakest office in the franchise, it has some major bad RNG potential to it and in general, it's a whole lot of just sitting around. I still really liked it though and understanding it as I played more. It's also probably the most daunting FNAF gameplay in the series, I never wanted to start the next night.

The Pizzeria: This is where the game shines, I love the Simulator aspect so much, it's so much fun, the minigames are great, the routes for getting money quick are awesome and strategising for getting the other endings like Blacklisted is so so fun. This part of the game is a genuine 10/10, I love it so much. 

Salvages: I cheated, I know how the code works for these guys, I have never lost to them, I have never suffered. Anyway, they are still super fun to do, at least for me. Not sure what it's like to beat Lefty legitimately, would probably be hype. 

Story: The story of this game is genuinely incredible, I have watched the final scene of this game so much, it is PEAK FNAF, I love it so much. The hidden secrets in this game are also incredible and I'm so glad that this game revealed so much more about the lore of the series in general. This game did so much for the theorising scene. I love it. 

Other: Today I watched my friend play this game for the first time and he broke helpy's back 42:8, I swear I could have died of laughter today.

This is such a good end to the Scott era of games (excluding UCN) every time i hear "Connection terminated" i genuinely get chills. The simulator part is honestly way more fun than the actual 'fnaf' part but still both are good. Once you learn the mechanics of the 'office' type of section it isnt really that hard, its more up to luck than anything. But considering this game is free and its THIS amazing, i think this is a must play.

listen this game is fine but like...
-the sound cues require your volume to be at max.
-when i do a sound cue with an animatronic it can just teleport to the other vent in a second.
-gameplay loop is boring at times.
-the game is mostly rng based with the vents.

over all 4.5/10.

Out of all of the older FNaF games, I do feel like Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator is the strongest out of the bunch. The gameplay feels really nice, especially the Pizzeria sections, I thoroughly enjoyed making my pizzeria look as cool as it could with my favorite decorations and animatronics (Trash and the Gang for the win), though I admit the office sections felt really unfair at times due to my inability to defend myself from the salvaged animatronics. The endings and the lore shown was very nice and I enjoyed hunting for those endings, especially the Completionist ending, which felt like a big reward for such a hard night. Overall, I would recommend this game, being free is a bonus for how nice this game is to just sit down with,
